List of telephone messages circulated in connection with
the mass meeting held on the Public Recreation Ground, West
Gate on January 10, 1932.

| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 11.30 a. m. | Officer i/c Special Branch | Central, Sinza, Louza, W.Hongkew, D.O."A" & Reserve Unit | A meeting in memory of one of the students killed in Nanking is now in progress on the Public Recreation Ground. There are about one thousand persons present and they have the coffin containing the remains of the deceased on the field. |
| 12.30 p. m. | Officer i/c Special Branch | Central, Sinza, Louza, W.Hongkew, Reserve Unit, & D.O."A" | The meeting on the Recreation Ground, West Gate, is of a communist character. The attendance are planning to hold a procession when the meeting concludes. |
| 1 p.m. | Supt. Robertson Special Branch | Central, Sinza, Louza, W.Hongkew, Reserve Unit & D.O."A" | The procession of participants in the meeting at West Gate has now started. The French Police have closed their gates on Boulevard des Deux Republiques. |
| 1.15 p. m. | Supt. Robertson Special Branch | Louza | The procession was moving north through the French Concession and at the moment was nearing the Great World. |
| 1.40 p. m. | Central | Hongkew, W.Hongkew | Inform Hongkew and West Hongkew that students are all at the corner of Nanking and Honan Roads. Probably they will be coming into your districts. A special look out to be attended to. |

与1932年1月10日在西门外公共游乐场举行的大会相关的 circulated 电话留言清单。

| 时间 | 发件人 | 收件人 | 留言性质 |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 上午11:30 | 特别处负责人 | 中央巡捕房、新闸、老闸、西虹口、“A”区督察官及后备队 | 纪念一名在南京遇害学生的集会正在公共游乐场进行。现场约有千人，并将装有死者遗体的棺材置于场内。 |
| 下午12:30 | 特别处负责人 | 中央巡捕房、新闸、老闸、西虹口、后备队及“A”区督察官 | 西门外游乐场的集会具有共产主义性质。与会者计划在集会结束后举行游行。 |
| 下午1:00 | 特别处罗伯逊警司 | 中央巡捕房、新闸、老闸、西虹口、后备队及“A”区督察官 | 西门集会的参与者游行队伍现已出发。法国警察已关闭其在两共和国路（Boulevard des Deux Republiques）的闸门。 |
| 下午1:15 | 特别处罗伯逊警司 | 老闸 | 游行队伍正穿过法租界向北移动，此刻已接近大世界。 |
| 下午1:40 | 中央巡捕房 | 虹口、西虹口 | 通知虹口和西虹口，学生均在南京路与河南路的拐角处。他们可能会进入你们的辖区。需特别警戒。 |
| 下午1:45 | 后备队 | 指挥室 | 下午1:42向南京路发出防暴呼叫（已通知伯恩少校）。 |
| 下午3:05 | 后备队 | 指挥室 | 防暴车于下午3:05返回。 |

（批注：Key. 请归档。1932年1月9日 16:1:32）
（批注：中共）

Extract from the Police Intelligence Report
dated January 11, 1931

Mass Meeting and Procession in memory of "Shanghai
Victim in the "December 17" Tragedy in Nanking

The mass meeting in memory of the "Shanghai" victim
in the "December 17" Tragedy in Nanking jointly convened
by the "Support Committee of the 'December 17' Tragedy
in Nanking" with an office in the Vincent English
School, No.3, Lane 84 Medhurst Road and the "National
Salvation Association of Shanghai Masses to Resist
Japan", 24 Wuting Road, was held in the Public Recreation
Ground, West Gate, at 11 a.m. January 10, some 1,000
persons mostly of the student and labouring types attending.
The proceedings opened with the attendance bowing three
times to the coffin containing the remains of the "Shanghai
victim, a student of the Vincent English School, and
keeping five minutes' silence. Representatives of the
China Public School, Woosung, the Shanghai College of
Law, Rue Pere Robert, the Vincent English School, Medhurst
Road, Western District Labourers' Federation, 445 Brenan
Road, C.O.L., and the "National Salvation Association of
Shanghai Masses to Resist Japan" formed the presidium.
The meeting appeared to be purely communistic, as speeches
of that nature were made by persons of the labouring class
who claimed to represent workers of the Dong Shing Cotton
Mill and other concerns as well as local unemployed
labourers. A Korean who claimed to represent the
Japanese Communist Party, delivered a speech denouncing
the Japanese militarists for the invasion of Manchuria
and announcing the cordial union and sympathy of
Japanese labourers with the Chinese in overthrowing

for letter to Fr.
Blue re class
cooperation.）

摘自1931年1月11日的警务情报报告

纪念南京“一二·一七”惨案中“上海受害者”的大会及游行

由设在麦赫斯特路84弄3号文生英文学校内的“南京‘一二·一七’惨案后援会”与位于吴淞路24号的“上海民众抗日救国会”联合召集的，纪念南京“一二·一七”惨案中“上海”受害者的群众大会，于1月10日上午11时在西门外公共游乐场举行，出席者约1000人，多为学生和劳工阶层。会议开始时，与会者向装有“上海”受害者（文生英文学校一名学生）遗体的棺材三鞠躬，并默哀五分钟。主席团由吴淞中国公学、北四川路罗伯特神父路上海法学院、麦赫斯特路文生英文学校、勃伦南路445号西区劳工联合会、C.O.L.（原文不清，可能指某组织缩写）以及“上海民众抗日救国会”的代表组成。会议似乎纯粹具有共产主义性质，因为自称代表东兴纱厂及其他企业工人以及当地失业劳工的劳工阶级人士发表了此类性质的演讲。一名自称代表日本共产党的朝鲜人发表演讲，谴责日本军国主义者入侵满洲，并宣布日本劳工在推翻

（批注：参见 D. 2901 关于阶级合作的致 Blue 神父信函。）

pages.en:
-2-

capitalists and imperialists. His oration was conveyed
to the attendance by an interpreter. Communist slogans
advocating the support of Communist Party and the Red
Army and the Soviet Government were shouted from time to
time and communistic pamphlets of no less than 19 varieties
and anti-Government and anti-Japanese literature of 16
kinds were distributed during the meeting. Meanwhile
the following resolutions were passed:-

1. That the failure of the Government to defend Chinchow
be opposed.

2. That the Government's oppressive measures against the
people's movement be opposed.

3. That the Government's massacre of people be opposed.

4. That absolute freedom of speech, assembly and publication
be secured.

5. That the people arm themselves of their own accord and
declare war on Japan.

6. That the death of the victims in the "December 17"
Tragedy be revenged.

7. That the coming of the International Enquiry Commission
to China be opposed.

8. That opposition be made to the Government for borrowing
big sums of money from other nations.

At 12.15 p.m. the meeting was concluded and the attendance
formed into a procession headed by the coffin containing
the remains of the "Shanghai" victim.

During the meeting, a man was arrested by the
Chinese police on duty on the Recreation Ground for
disseminating communistic literature. His apprehension,
however, was resented by the attendance who shouted
slogans "Down with the running dogs of the Kuomintang"
and "Let the Picketing Groups Attack", whereupon the
police liberated their prisoner who appeared to be of the
student type but there was no indication as to what
school he belonged.

资本家和帝国主义者的斗争中与中国人同心同德、声息相通。他的演说由一名翻译传达给与会者。期间不时高呼拥护共产党、红军和苏维埃政府的共产主义口号，会上分发了不少于19种共产主义小册子以及16种反政府和反日文献。同时通过了以下决议：-

1. 反对政府未能保卫锦州。

2. 反对政府对民众运动的压迫措施。

3. 反对政府屠杀人民。

4. 确保绝对的言论、集会和出版自由。

5. 人民自动武装起来，对日宣战。

6. 为“一二·一七”惨案中的死者报仇。

7. 反对国际调查团来华。

8. 反对政府向其他国家巨额借款。

下午12:15，会议结束，与会者组成游行队伍，由装有“上海”受害者遗体的棺材开道。

会议期间，一名男子因在游乐场散发共产主义文献而被执勤的中国警察逮捕。然而，这一逮捕行为引起与会者的不满，他们高呼“打倒国民党走狗”和“让纠察队进攻”等口号，随后警察释放了这名囚犯，该囚犯看似学生模样，但无法确定其所属学校。

- 3 -

The procession then marched along Ling Ying Road,
Fang Zia Road, Min Kuo Road, and then entered French
Concession via Rue Voisin and to Boulevard de Montigny.
On their way communistic slogans were shouted and like
literature disseminated, and on-lookers were called upon
to participate in the demonstration by means of six
megaphones. The processionists entered the
Settlement at Thibet Road, turning eastward along
Nanking Road. At this junction, the attendance had
swelled to over 2,000. In view of the fanatical
utterances of the mob and its general hostile attitude
and with the idea of heading it off at some point in a
northerly direction towards Chapei, the party of police
which encountered the procession at this point deemed
it advisable to permit it to proceed. It then
continued east on Nanking Road, north on Kiangse Road,
along Hongkong Road, Szechuen Road, north Szechuen
Road, and Tiendong Road. At the corner of Chapoo
Road the coffin was detached from the procession
and conveyed by coolies to the Szechuen Fellow Country-
men's Guild, Kiangwan Road and Hwa Yuen Road corner.
The procession then continued to Seward Road, East
Seward Road, turning eastward along Arthur Road up
to Broadway Road, where it turned westward and on
reaching the Hongkew Bridge it was effectively dis-
persed by the Police Reserve Unit. A student of
the Shanghai Fine Arts College, French Concession,
was apprehended for attempted assault on the police but
was later released with a caution.

Subject (in full) Student Demonstration

Made by D.S.I. Palmer Forwarded by

Sir,
At 1.45 p.m., 10-1-32, in response to a telephone message
received from the Control Room to the effect that a large pro-
cession of students were proceeding from Nanking Road to Hongkew
district, all available police attached to this station turned
out and subsequently encountered the procession, which was com-
posed of between two or three thousand persons, on Broadway Road
near the Hongkew Creek, heading South. At this juncture, a party
of Police from the Reserve Unit under Supt. Fairburn arrived on
the scene and as the students were shouting slogans of an anti-
Government and anti-Japanese nature, a baton charge was conducted
which subsequently broke up the procession. One person named Sung
Yong Kwung (孫防錕), age 18, native of Anwhei, student at the
Shanghai Arts Middle School, French Concession was taken into
custody for striking P.S. 59 Harrison with a stick, he was however
later released after being severely cautioned. Another male Chi-
nese named Sia Kung Tau (謝賡) shop assistant at the Wah Cheng
Ironmongers Shop, Broadway, was found in an alleyway suffering
from injuries to the face which he stated he received in the above
melée, he was sent to St. Lukes hospital but was not detained,
Doctor's chit "Laceration of face, not serious".

It was learned from Supt. Robertson who also appeared on
the scene that the procession originated from Nantao where at
the West Gate at about 11.00 a.m., this instance, a communistic meet-
ing was held. The students entered the Settlement at about 1.0p.m.
and marched via Thibet, Nanking, Kiangse, Hongkong, Szechuen and
Tiendong Roads and East along East Seward Road when for some
un-accountable reason they turned South into Arthur Road to Broad-
way.

主题（全称） 学生示威

由 副督察帕尔默 制作 转呈

先生，
1932年1月10日下午1:45，接到指挥室电话留言，称一大群学生正从南京路向虹口区行进，本巡捕房所有可用警力随即出动，随后在靠近虹口港的百老汇路上遭遇了这支由两三千人组成的游行队伍，队伍正向南行进。此时，由费尔伯恩警司率领的后备队警察分队抵达现场，由于学生高呼反政府和反日性质的口号，警方实施了警棍冲锋，最终驱散了游行队伍。一名名为孙防錕（Sung Yong Kwung，音译），18岁，安徽籍，法租界上海艺术中学学生的人，因用棍棒击打59号巡捕哈里森而被拘留，但在受到严厉警告后被释放。另一名华裔男子谢賡（Sia Kung Tau，音译），百老汇路华成五金店店员，被发现躺在一条小巷里，面部受伤，他称是在上述混战中受的伤，他被送往圣卢克医院，但未被拘留，医生证明为“面部撕裂伤，不严重”。

从同样出现在现场的罗伯逊警司处获悉，游行队伍起源于南市，当天上午11点左右，在西门外举行了一次共产主义集会。学生们大约在下午1:00进入租界，途经西藏路、南京路、江西路、香港路、四川路和天潼路，并沿东华德路向东行进，随后出于某种无法解释的原因，他们向南转入亚瑟路至百老汇路。

pages.en:
Extract from the Police Intelligence Report
dated January 7, 1932

University Students entertain local journalists

Four representatives of the "University Students
National Salvation Committee to Resist Japan" entertained
two local journalists to a tea party in the Shanghai
College of Fine Arts, 440 Rue du Marche, French Concession,
at 4 p.m. January 6, when Hsu Wen-hsi (徐文熙), a
student of the College, who presided, informed the
attendance of the following :-

1. That a drive will be conducted to solicit contributions
from the public for a fund which will be used in
furthering the anti-Japanese movement and compensating
the families of victims of the suppression of the
recent anti-Japanese demonstration at Nanking.

2. A mass meeting will be held on the Public Recreation
Ground, West Gate, at 9 a.m. January 10 in memory of
Yang Dung-heng (楊桐恆), a student, who was
drowned at Nanking.

According to the students, they intend to bring
the coffin containing Yang's remains to the meeting,
at the conclusion of which a demonstration in the
form of procession, headed by the coffin, will be
carried out.

摘自1932年1月7日的警务情报报告

大学生宴请本地记者

“大学生抗日救国会”的四名代表于1月6日下午4时在法租界马谢路440号上海美术专科学校举行茶话会，招待了两名本地记者。主持会议的是该校学生徐文熙，他向与会者通报了以下情况：-

1. 将开展募捐活动，向公众筹集资金，用于推进抗日运动，并补偿近期南京抗日示威镇压行动中受害者的家属。

2. 将于1月10日上午9时在西门公共游乐场举行群众集会，纪念在南京溺水身亡的学生杨桐恒（楊桐恆）。

据学生们称，他们打算将装有杨氏遗体的棺材带到集会现场，集会结束后，将以棺材为前导，举行游行示威。

FRENCH POLICE INTELLIGENCE REPORT.
January 11, 1932.

Activities of the Chinese Communist Party.
Memorial Service for Students Killed at Nanking.

At 10.30 a.m. January 10 a service in memory
of the victims of the Nanking tragedy (December 17)
was held on the Public Recreation Ground, West Gate.
Among the Labour Unions and other public bodies which
took part in the ceremony were the Union of Merchant
Seamen, the Union of Linotype Workers, the Union of
Workers in the western district of Shanghai, the
Women's anti-Japanese Association, the Korean anti-
Japanese Association, the Formosan anti-Japanese
Association, the Union of Students of the Wensen
English School, the Union of China College Students,
the Union of the Dah Cheng College Students, etc.
The coffin of Yang Tung Heng, a student of the
Wensen English College, who was killed at Nanking on
December 17, 1931, was placed in the centre of the Ground.
The Chinese Communist Party naturally took the advantage
of the occasion to despatch representatives to this
meeting to convert it into a Communistic demonstration.
In fact, in the course of the meeting several Communistic
addresses were delivered and the following Red slogans
were cried out:-
Long live the Chinese Communist Party.
Long live the Red Armies.
Down with the Kuomintang.
Let us organize a Soviet Government.
The following resolutions were then passed
by the memorial service meeting:
1) To issue a circular telegram protesting
against the withdrawal from Chingchou.
2) To issue a circular telegram protesting against
the sale of Manchuria by the Kuomintang Government.
3) To issue a circular telegram inviting the
masses in the various cities to organise anti-Japanese
and National Salvation Associations.
4) To issue a circular telegram inviting the
people to arm themselves against the Japanese invaders.
5) To issue a circular telegram inviting the
masses in Shanghai to declare a general strike, to
refuse to pay the taxes and to intensify the anti-
Japanese movement.
6) To issue a circular telegram protesting against
the massacre of the people by the government.
7) To reorganize the Anti-Japanese Association for
national salvation.
8) To insist on the immediate punishment of Chang
Hsueh Liang.

At 12.10 p.m. at the close of the service a
procession was formed which followed the coffin of Yang
Tung Heng. The procession traversed French Concession
and was directed into Thibet Road and Nanking Road towards
the Japanese Consulate-General for the purpose of organizing
an anti-Japanese demonstration at that place.
At 1.30 p.m. the demonstrators were dispersed on
Broadway by the Shanghai Municipal Police who arrested a
student named Hu Ban Shan, a student of Vincent English
School. He was released at 5 p.m. D
During the meeting and the procession communistic
circulars of many kinds were distributed. The following
organizations were responsible for the circulars in question.

法国警察情报报告。
1932年1月11日。

中国共产党活动。
南京遇难学生追悼会。

1月10日上午10时30分，在西门公共游乐场举行了纪念南京惨案（12月17日）受害者的追悼仪式。参加仪式的劳工工会和其他公共团体包括海员工会、排字工人工会、上海西区工人工会、妇女反日会、朝鲜反日会、台湾反日会、文生英语学校学生联合会、中国学院学生联合会、大成学院学生联合会等。1931年12月17日在南京遇害的文生英语学院学生杨桐恒（Yang Tung Heng）的棺材被放置在场地中央。中国共产党自然利用这一机会派遣代表参加此次会议，将其转变为共产主义示威活动。事实上，在会议过程中发表了几次共产主义演讲，并高呼以下红色口号：-
中国共产党万岁。
红军万岁。
打倒国民党。
让我们组织苏维埃政府。
随后，追悼会通过了以下决议：
1) 发出通电，抗议从锦州撤军。
2) 发出通电，抗议国民党政府出卖满洲。
3) 发出通电，邀请各城市民众组织抗日救国会。
4) 发出通电，号召人民武装起来对抗日本侵略者。
5) 发出通电，号召上海民众举行总罢工，拒绝纳税，并加强抗日运动。
6) 发出通电，抗议政府屠杀人民。
7) 改组抗日救国会。
8) 坚持立即惩办张学良。

下午12时10分，仪式结束时组成了一支跟随杨桐恒棺材的游行队伍。游行队伍穿过法租界，转向西藏路和南京路，朝日本总领事馆方向进发，目的是在那里组织抗日示威。
下午1时30分，上海公共租界工部局警务处在百老汇路驱散了示威者，并逮捕了一名名为胡半山（Hu Ban Shan）的学生，他是文森特英语学校的学生。他于下午5时被释放。D
在会议和游行期间，分发了多种共产主义传单。下列组织对这些传单负责。
